items.t: DLLL 2X Dell ETF Plunges 16% as Dell Tumbles 8% in AI Hardware Selloff; Hewlett Packard Enterprise Falls 4%
items.sum: Dell posted record AI orders and a $95 billion backlog, yet its leveraged ETF just lost a sixth of its value in a day. What is spooking the AI hardware trade, and why is the smallest drop landing on the company at the center of the probe?

items.t: Super Micro Slides 7% Despite Gartner’s $957 Billion AI Server Forecast; Dell Falls 4%, Hewlett Packard Enterprise Dips
items.sum: Gartner just pointed to a near trillion dollar AI server market, yet Wall Street is selling the very companies that build the machines. A sudden shake-up at the top of the chip world explains why, and one server maker looks far more exposed than its rivals.
